description: ID5 mobile in-app server-to-server fetch on api.id5-sync.com/ga/v1. Cookie sync on /i/ and /s/ is not contracted. CTV /gc/v1 is not contracted.

params.name: partner
params.description: It is the ID5 Partner Number. ID5 documents partner as required on /ga/v1.
params.fix_hint: Set partner to the Partner Number ID5 issued. Use 173 only while testing.

params.name: ts
params.description: It is the request timestamp. ID5 documents ts as required, as an ISO-8601 string with a time zone offset.
params.fix_hint: Set ts to an ISO-8601 timestamp with offset, such as 2013-02-01T12:52:34+09:00.

params.name: bundle
params.description: It is the app identifier. ID5 documents bundle as required: package name on Android, numeric ID on iOS.
params.fix_hint: Set bundle to the app package name or iOS numeric ID.

params.name: ver
params.description: It is the application version. ID5 documents ver as required.
params.fix_hint: Set ver to the app version string.

params.name: ip
params.description: It is the IPv4 address closest to the device. ID5 documents ip as required.
params.fix_hint: Send the device-facing IPv4 address, unhashed.

params.name: ua
params.description: It is the device default-browser user agent. ID5 documents ua as required.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw user agent string, unhashed.

params.name: hem
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hash of the cleansed email. ID5 documents hem as sha256 when present.
params.fix_hint: Cleanse the email, hash it with SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: phone
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hash of the cleansed phone number.
params.fix_hint: Cleanse the phone number, hash it with SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. ID5 documents hem as a SHA-256 digest of a cleansed email.
rules.fix_hint: Cleanse the email, hash it with SHA-256, and send it as hem.
